name: DMD 5208
title: 3D Motion I
description: Designed to prepare graduate students for careers in motion graphics, advertising, branding, and animation fields. Courses provide students an understanding of the collaborative function of industry during the production process as well as the development of their unique style of independent filmmaking during preproduction, production, and postproduction of their project. In addition, this course allows students to create their own motion project, animation, and/or visual effects thesis. Students are encouraged to develop visual storytelling skills while using a variety of techniques, including traditional hand-drawn, stop-motion, 2D and 3D motion graphics and computer animation.
requirement_description: Open to DMD graduate students, others with instructor consent.
